submitted.rationale: EQE peaked at Sb fraction 0.622 (0.0336%). Nearby measurements were lower: 0.517 gave 0.0244, 0.645 gave 0.0273 and 0.720 gave 0.0256. The Sb-poor end was lower still (0.285 gave 0.0129). A parabola through the three points around the peak puts the maximum at about 0.62. This composition is on the Sb-rich side of rutile CrSbO4.

rejected.reason: The GP suggested it for exploration only; its mean prediction was about 0 and the Sb-rich edge was not expected to be better
